{{Quote|Not very populated. Less than three million people, all told. Or at least back when this was compiled. Doesn't look like anyone's taken official notice of the planet in fifteen years. Just the sort of place a Jedi might choose to hide from the Empire.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Jomark''' was the second of six [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Jomark system/Legends|Jomark system]]. Originally known as '''Bynas''', it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as he expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].

==Description==
The second of six planets in the [[Jomark system/Legends|Jomark system]], Jomark was the only one capable of supporting life, and the only planet to be colonized. The planet was mostly covered by [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], with one small continent called Kalish, and thousands of small island clusters dotting the surface. It had a population of 2.8 million spread across Kalish. These colonists lived by [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] and sea [[Farm/Legends|farming]].<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
Jomark was once home to a [[Unidentified Jomark species|native species]] that built the [[High Castle]], but these beings were long gone by the time of [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonization during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era a few thousand years before the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DFRS" /> A minor world, Jomark wasn't well-settled and few planetary maps were logged in records of star chart updates. A galactic survey team visited some [[6 BBY/Legends|fifteen years]] before the arrival of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the world, giving the world its last official notice until it gained prominence with rumors of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] appearance there.<ref name="HTTES" />

It was at [[High Castle|his residence]] on Jomark that [[Joruus C'baoth]] awaited Skywalker's arrival.<ref name="DFR" />

In a town near the High Castle, Joruus C'baoth set up his rule, including solving disputes, which he later had Luke do. In one argument, C'baoth used Force lightning on a citizen for attacking another, alarming Luke.<ref name="DFR" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] captured Jomark during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Another Tuckerization: Mark Jones of Tampa. Fortunately, Mark never took offense that Jomark was only a ''minor'' world.|Timothy Zahn|<ref name="HTTE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>}}
Jomark was first mentioned in the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first volume in the [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="HttE" /> It first appeared in the [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', the trilogy's second entry.<ref name="DFR" /> The planet was named by Zahn after his friend Mark Jones.<ref name="HTTE20" />
